statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and unexplained syncope
There is concern for underlying arrhythmia in the context of known sick sinus syndrome (I49.5)
The service is for further diagnostic evaluation to correlate intermittent symptoms with cardiac rhythm disturbances
The diagnosis code I49.5 (sick sinus syndrome) was submitted
The diagnosis code R42 (dizziness) was submitted
The diagnosis code R55 (syncope) was submitted
The claim was denied with reason code CO-97
The denial reason is that the service is bundled into another covered procedure and is not separately payable
